input_images.role: reviewed Ember Basin identity reference and edit target

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent stationary defensive structure sprite for a small top-down real-time card battler
Input images: Image 1 is the reviewed Ember Basin card portrait and is the identity reference; preserve the same object.
Primary request: create a clean, original, full-object arena sprite of the Ember Basin, isolated on true transparency.
Subject: one squat defensive launcher, an open copper-rimmed bowl holding a small emberseed, with a fixed upward-sloping dark rootwood launch trough, visible round copper pivot, and broad rootwood braces down to a compact stable base.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted game illustration, simplified bold shapes and clear material separation, consistent with a warm woodland workshop world.
Composition/framing: show the whole object from the same three-quarter view, centered, upright, filling most of a square canvas with safe transparent padding; make the outer silhouette and large launcher channel readable when displayed about 13 pixels tall.
Lighting/mood: warm forge highlights against dark rootwood, restrained ember glow.
Materials/textures: hammered copper plates and rivets, dark carved rootwood grain, one bright emberseed.
Constraints: retain the portrait's defining open launch bowl, raised trough, side pivot, paired braces, and copper-rootwood identity; keep the object stationary and grounded; actual transparent alpha around every edge.
Avoid: any background, environment, ground plane, cast shadow, extra object, character, text, logo, border, disconnected debris, cropped components, exaggerated spark or flame effects, or animation frames.
